Process

How We Deliver

Kodex Designs believes in transparency every step of the way, keeping you in the loop with every executed plan.

Discovery

We get to know your brand, your goals, and the audience you intend to reach through conversations and discovery calls.

Strategy & Planning

We draft a tailored action plan with clear deliverables, timelines, KPIs, and the tools and platforms we will use.

Design & Build

Our team sets the plan in motion, and you are updated on progress at every stage of the build.

Launch & Support

We make every necessary retouch before launch. Only when you are satisfied do we go live — then we stay on for ongoing improvements.

FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

What is included in a branding project?

Typically strategy and positioning, a logo system, colour and typography direction, and a set of brand guidelines. Scope is agreed up front.

How long does branding take?

Most identity projects run four to eight weeks depending on the number of rounds and the breadth of applications required.

Can you rebrand an existing business?

Yes. We handle full rebrands as well as lighter refreshes where the existing equity is worth keeping.

Do we get the source files?

Yes — full vector source files and exported formats for web and print are handed over at the end of the project.
